purpose: Fail-closed evidence gate separating historical REPLAY functional validation from real SHADOW_LIVE runtime SLO evidence.
required_controls: evaluation plan preregistered and independently timestamped before sample
run manifests prove zero dropped evaluations and zero sequence gaps
REPLAY timing trace marked reconstructed and not runtime-SLO-claimable
SHADOW_LIVE timing trace uses observed timestamps and valid clock-sync evidence
eight stage latencies derived from timestamps, not trusted scalar input
window-closed-on-arrival, processing-missed-window, stale and decision-too-late rates
shadow signal chain independently timestamped before entry-window close
oracle generated only after entry-window close
zero order submissions and zero wagers

result_semantics.FAIL_CLOSED: Any scope, sample, clock, timing, completeness, latency, FP/FN, window or no-wager control fails.
result_semantics.PASS: Both replay functional evidence and real shadow runtime SLO evidence pass the preregistered policy. CONTROLLED_LIVE remains false.
